sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Operational phone sitting at 15%. Standby to recharge before commencing patrols; resumed at 23%.
Patrolled through Lorne Street, no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and High Street, commencing welfare checks and ensuring visible presence.
Arrived at Fort Street, showing presence and scoping for any vagrants or issues, all clear.
Scoped out Fort Lane, no issues.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep completed; standby to show presence and await response calls.
Continuing patrols and making way to next checkpoint.
Check-in at the corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, area thoroughly cleared.
Welfare checks completed at Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Bakery, all clear.
Welfare check completed at Little Albert's Coffee, Formery and Sky Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Check-in at top of Victoria Street, welfare checks commenced on all stores, all clear. Standby to show presence and await response calls.
Arrived at last check-in Aotea Square, full sweep completed, huge inflatables present. A few street vagrants outside the old Coffee Club but causing no problems. Ending Alpha Route.
Report made to the Community Patrol team regarding a group of street-associated individuals congregating at Fort Street pocket park area causing a disturbance.
Response call from Michael Hill — male individual causing a disturbance inside the store, requesting assistance to escort the POI out.

Arrived at response location; POI had already left. New employees had been assisted by Auckland Council as they did not have our contact details — gave them our number to call 24/7 throughout the week.
Arrived at Pocket Park; group of street vagrants not causing any visible trouble. Stationed presence until further concerns identified.
Check-in at top of Mayoral Drive, quick scope of the area, all clear. Commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses, all clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library; a few street vagrants congregating but no concerns or problems.
Check-in at corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses in the lane.
Arrived at HQ, standby to recharge Ops Phone (7%). Also taking morning interval.
Continuing patrols through Queen Street ensuring strong security presence.
Response call from 51 Victoria Street West — male individual causing a disturbance in front of their store.
Arrived at response location; male POI nowhere to be found. Called them back and they advised he had already left.
Response call from Unichem Pharmacy, 151 Lower Queen Street.
Response call from Cotton On — a fire inside the rubbish bin in front of their building.
Arrived at place of interest; the fire had been extinguished.
A member of the public stopped us and raised a concern about a large bee hive on the sign at the corner of Queen and Victoria Street.
Arrived at the wasp nest; contacted an Auckland Council Warden due to the public safety matter. Standing by until they arrive.
Auckland Council Wardens arrived. Standing by to keep the public safe and directing them to cross the road or use an alternative path.
Continuing patrols now that Council Wardens have arrived, leaving the matter with them.
Arrived at HQ, standby for lunch break and to recharge the Ops Phone.
No issues occurred during this period. Morning shift completed.
Equipment handover: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radios.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Response call regarding a male individual inside the premises suspected of stealing products; en route to location. (Photos/video on file.)
Arrived at response location; staff advised the individual had already left without any products in his possession, all clear.
Standing by in the middle of Queen Street for any issues.
Welfare checks completed, all clear; heading back to HQ to wait for the 2nd guard to arrive:
Arrived at HQ, standing by outside the entrance for guard arrival.
Welfare check at Nike Store, Cotton On, Localito. Saw a crowd of public outside the Ippondo entrance and went to check — a male vagrant was lying unconscious on the floor. Standing by.
Standing by outside Ippondo with the unconscious male vagrant, assisting until emergency services arrive.
Stood down assistance for the unconscious male vagrant — he is awake and doing well. Standing by outside HQ until management arrives.
Welfare check at Ippondo, Mobile Planet, The Sale Shop, Footlocker and Fun Tech, all clear. Standing by outside HQ until management arrives.
Management arrived; notified of the 2nd guard not yet being on. Following until 2nd guard arrives.
Welfare check at the corner of Durham Street, both Wilson's Carparks.
2nd guard arrived on shift, gearing up and having a debrief before commencing patrols.
Welfare checks; standing by at the top corner of Wellesley and Queen Street:
Standing down from the beehive area, saw a female vagrant walking around the top of Aotea Square shouting and swearing at members of the public. Patrolling the area. (Video on file.)
Arrived at Aotea Square patrolling to locate the female vagrant causing a disturbance.
Message from the Heart of the City community team regarding a group of individuals consuming illegal substances at a bus stop, 170 Queen Street; en route.
Arrived at response location; asked the vagrants to move along with their belongings. Standing by until all clear.
Group of vagrants moved along. Resuming patrols at the top of Queen Street to commence welfare checks.
Commencing welfare checks on the middle-top of Queen Street, splitting as we go down.
Standing by on the corner of Wyndham Street; welfare checks from Farmers and Mecca down to Hallensteins and OPSM.
Corner of Wyndham Street all clear, continuing welfare check patrols down Queen Street.
Welfare checking Vulcan Lane and businesses in the area.
Encountered a group of vagrants taking shelter on private property; asked them to move along, all clear.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane from New Balance to Align to Little Unity to High Street Supermarket, all clear. Standing by in front of High Street Supermarket.
Response from the community team regarding a group of individuals consuming illegal substances; moved along. (Video on file.)
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane; commencing welfare checks down the bottom of High Street.
Welfare checks from Optics 1 to High Street Supermarket, down to Bakers High Street and Corner Bar, all clear, patrolling to Fort Lane.
Welfare check Shortland Street — Shortland Mart, Taco Bell, The North Face, all clear.
Welfare check, all clear; standing by at KFC maintaining presence:
Welfare check of the whole of Fort Lane, all clear; heading back to HQ to standby in office until floor checks commence.
Arrived at HQ, standby in office until floor checks commence.
Floor checks completed; standby in office charging Ops Phone due to low battery.
Ops Phone charging in office (ongoing through to 19:45).
Received a call from management to let them inside office; standby outside entrance for their arrival.
Let management inside office, all clear; gearing up and commencing patrols.
Welfare check Avachi's Kebab and Chicken, Mid City, Timezone Centre, 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Top half of Queen Street all clear, patrolling up Wellesley to Lorne Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street commencing sweep of the area.
Welfare check at Lorne Staircase Mural, all clear, continuing patrols.
Full sweep of Lorne Street, welfare check on remaining businesses open, all clear, patrolling down High Street.
Received a call from management to head down to Britomart.
While making our way down, a vagrant was seen taking shelter in front of Coco Tea; successfully moved him along, continuing response.
Welfare check Metropolis Residence, Circle K, Vagabond, all clear, patrolling to Chancery Square.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place and Chancery Square, welfare check on all businesses, all clear, patrolling to Britomart.
Welfare check Short Mart, Shortland Street, all clear, patrolling down Fort Lane.
Full sweep of Fort Lane, all clear, arriving at Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart commencing sweep, maintaining presence until guard handover.
Full sweep of Britomart, welfare check McDonald's, all clear, heading back to HQ to let the standby guard in.
Arrived at HQ, letting in the standby guard and standing by until guard handover.
Afternoon shift concluded, handing over to Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief before gearing up and commencing patrols.
Standing by outside due to bad weather, taking shelter.
Welfare check Localito, McDonald's Queen Street, Avachi, Timezone Centre, 77 Convenience Store, all clear. Standing by at McDonald's Queens.
Encountered a female individual shouting and swearing inside McDonald's Queens; she walked out on her own free will.
Welfare check McDonald's Queens, heading to Bar 101.
Full sweep of Darby Street, welfare check Thai Food, Celines, Pizza Club, all clear. Arrived at Bar 101, standing by maintaining presence.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear, continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Text message from Jo&Joes regarding a male individual causing a disturbance inside the premises; en route.
While en route to Jo&Joes, received another text from the same person advising assistance is no longer needed but they will contact us if anything happens. Continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Shortland Street, welfare check Shortland Mart, all clear, patrolling down Fort Lane.
Welfare check Jo&Joes, The Right Track, Mr Murdochs, all clear, patrolling down Fort Lane.
Arrived at Sapphires Night Club, standing by showing presence.
Full sweep of Fort Lane, welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, all clear, patrolling to Britomart.
Welfare check McDonald's Queens and guard, all clear.
Full sweep of Britomart, no heavy footwork in the area, patrolling down Quay Street.
Welfare check Kemuri and guard, all clear, standing by at Reign N Pour.
Standing by at Reign N Pour (ongoing through 00:41).

Encountered an intoxicated male individual who was very aggressive towards members of the public at Reign N Pour; asked him to move along but he refused and began cussing at the guards. Standing by for any issues.
Standing by at Reign N Pour (ongoing through 01:30).
Welfare check Reign N Pour, all clear, patrolling to HQ.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at HQ charging Ops Phone due to low battery.
Charging Ops Phone in office (ongoing through 02:50).
Received a call from a fellow guard to let him inside the office; standby outside until he arrives.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street, standing by for any issues.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store, all clear, patrolling to Bar 101.
Arrived at Bar 101, standing by for any issues.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear, heading to office to commence 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ commencing 30-minute break, responding to any calls that occur.
30-minute break completed, commencing patrols up Victoria Street West.
Full sweep of Victoria Street West, welfare check Skymart Convenience Store, all clear, patrolling down Federal Street.
Full sweep of Federal Street, all clear, arrived at Federal Square commencing sweep.
Full sweep of Federal Square, welfare check Cathedral area and Liston House, no vagrants or issues, patrolling down Wyndham to Queen Street.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street, all clear, patrolling Queen Street.
Welfare check Queen Street, all clear. Arrived at Britomart commencing full sweep due to a massive crowd in the area.
Full sweep of Britomart, welfare check McDonald's, all clear, patrolling down Customs Street West.
Full sweep of Customs Street West, welfare check Customs Convenience Store, all clear, patrolling down Fort Street.
Welfare check Gore Street, no issues identified.
Full sweep of Fort Street, welfare check Commerce Street, Jo&Joes, all clear, patrolling up to High Street.
Welfare check Shortland Street, all clear, patrolling up High Street.
Welfare check thoroughly of Vulcan Lane, all clear, continuing patrols up High Street.
Standing by at Freyberg Place sweeping the area (ongoing through 05:50).
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, welfare check O'Connell Street, Chancery Street, all clear, patrolling down High Street.
Welfare check of the whole of High Street, all clear, patrolling to McDonald's Queens.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street, standing by for any issues.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street, heading back to HQ to standby for guard handover.
Arrived at office, standing by until guard handover.
Night shift concluded, handing over to Morning Shift.
